quest.title: Neko Is a Cat: Ding-a-Ling Metal Ball
quest.description: Neko, "Provisional Head Priestess of the Asase Shrine," seems to have business with you...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Primogem x20, Mora x10000

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Meow meow, when did that stone become the spitting image of me...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's the statue?

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: The stone human says that he will finish knocking on this stone soon.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Hibiki will be so happy when she returns.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Hmm, yes. This stone is good, but we must dress the shrine's surroundings up a bit, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Please, help me hang these round, tinkling metal balls around the shrine.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: These things were prepared by Hibiki. If memory serves, Domeki gave them to her because she loved playing with me and other children. It took quite a lot of effort to find them again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Huh. These are... bells?

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: "Bells?" I am not sure what those are, but Hibiki used to use these metal balls when playing with me.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: She would put the metal balls on the ground, and then knock them far away. They would make this tinkling noise whenever they moved.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: I do not understand what power they possessed, but the sound they made would always attract myself and the other cats to chase them.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: I came to understand, therefore, that the reason why few people have come to pay respects is because the shrine presently lacks metal balls.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Thus, I request your help in hanging these metal balls in high places.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: That way, humans will hear the tinkling of the metal balls and come to this shrine, and they will not lose their way.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: The Offering Box will be full of Mora, and the shrine will thrive... and Hibiki will be very happy when she returns.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: So, please help me hang these metal balls around the shrine.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I got it.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Thank you, meow meow.

talks.objective: Hang the bells around the shrine

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: These metal balls will attract more people. That will surely please Hibiki.

talks.objective: Hang the bells around the shrine
Hang the bells around the shrine

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Have you hung them all up?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: All done.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Meow meow, wonderful. This will surely make the shrine a livelier place.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Hmm. Why haven't lots of humans come here yet?

choices.text: I don't think they'll come so quickly...

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Ah, humans are so hard to understand. Well, you are an exception, of course. You are more enlightened.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: There may not be any people now... But at least those little rascals won't get lost anymore, meow meow.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: The stone human says that the stone will be ready very soon. Do come and see it.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: ...Hmm, yes, there was one other thing. A strange thing.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: I went to ask those two green humans about Hibiki and Domeki.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Both of them said that they didn't know Hibiki or anything about her.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: But the tall green human said that he had read about an "Ako Domeki."

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: He talked about... "bandit" this and "bounty" that... Whatever the case, he was trying to say that Domeki was a bad person.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: There must be some mistake. Hibiki would always play with him, so Domeki must've been a good person.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: That human's comprehension must be lacking. You're still the most reliable human after all, it seems...

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Ah, when will Hibiki come back...
